India's First Petroglyph Conservation Park Developing in Ladakh

India's first conservation park for petroglyphs is taking shape in Ladakh. The project involves the relocation of 31 ancient petroglyphs to a proposed park in Leh. This initiative aims to preserve these historical rock carvings.
